original_query: select c_custkey, c_name, sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue, c_acctbal, n_name, c_address, c_phone, c_comment from customer, orders, lineitem, nation where c_custkey = o_custkey and l_orderkey = o_orderkey and o_orderdate >= date '1994-12-01' and o_orderdate < date '1994-12-01' + interval '3' month and l_returnflag = 'R' and c_nationkey = n_nationkey group by c_custkey, c_name, c_acctbal, c_phone, n_name, c_address, c_comment order by revenue desc limit 20;
rewritten_query:
select
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_name,
    sum(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) as revenue,
    c.c_acctbal,
    n.n_name,
    c.c_address,
    c.c_phone,
    c.c_comment
from customer as c
join orders as o
    on o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
join lineitem as l
    on l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
join nation as n
    on n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
where o.o_orderdate >= date '1994-12-01'
  and o.o_orderdate < date '1995-03-01'
  and l.l_returnflag = 'R'
group by c.c_custkey, n.n_nationkey
order by revenue desc
limit 20;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Replace `date '1994-12-01' + interval '3' month` with the equivalent literal `date '1995-03-01'`, eliminating the implicit date-to-timestamp cast and keeping the predicate sargable on o_orderdate.

Convert the implicit comma-style joins into explicit ANSI JOINs with clear ON conditions (c_custkey=o_custkey, l_orderkey=o_orderkey, c_nationkey=n_nationkey), improving readability and join-condition clarity without changing semantics.

Move the local filters (o_orderdate range, l_returnflag='R') into the WHERE clause of the explicit-join form; the optimizer can then consider a date-first plan: filter orders in the ~3 month window (roughly 0.5M of 15M orders) before joining lineitem, instead of relying only on a full lineitem scan.

Recommended supporting indexes (DDL outside the query): `CREATE INDEX ON orders (o_orderdate, o_orderkey, o_custkey);` and `CREATE INDEX ON lineitem (l_orderkey, l_returnflag) INCLUDE (l_extendedprice, l_discount);` to enable a date-range scan on orders and covering lookups into lineitem filtered by returnflag R.
